items.lede: The AI company is expected to set its valuation range this week, the Wall Street Journal reported.
items.title: Anthropic reportedly plans to move forward with IPO plans

items.lede: The AI company behind the Claude chatbot will offer its shares at between $70 and $78.
items.title: Anthropic heads for $1.3 trillion valuation in major stock market listing

items.lede: The company could end up being worth a hefty $1.404 trillion if its shares list at the top of the price range, on a fully diluted basis.
items.title: Anthropic sets IPO price range of $70 to $78 per share to reach an implied valuation of $1.404 trillion

items.lede: Each of the seven co-founders plans to sell exactly the same number of shares in the IPO, which would bring each of them about $250 million in cash at the midpoint of the price range while leaving the group in control of the company.
